segment_title: WHEN AMAZON SAYS NO — THE A-TO-Z GUARANTEE
script_text: MOST OF WHAT YOU BUY THERE ISN'T SOLD BY AMAZON — IT'S SOLD BY THIRD-PARTY SELLERS. / AMAZON HAS SAID MORE THAN 60% OF SALES IN ITS STORE COME FROM INDEPENDENT SELLERS. / SO WHEN IT GOES WRONG, PEOPLE GET BOUNCED BETWEEN AMAZON AND A SELLER WHO WON'T ANSWER. / THAT'S WHAT THE A-TO-Z GUARANTEE IS FOR. YOU FILE IT THROUGH YOUR ORDERS PAGE. / AND AMAZON DECIDES THE CLAIM — NOT THE SELLER WHO TOOK YOUR MONEY. / IT COVERS ITEMS THAT NEVER ARRIVED, AND ITEMS THAT ARRIVED DAMAGED OR NOTHING LIKE THE LISTING. / BUT PEOPLE GET DENIED. AND WHEN THEY GET DENIED, THEY GIVE UP. / ESCALATE IT. PUT IT IN WRITING. / LISTEN TO WHAT HAPPENED TO HER.
